title: Resilient Logistics under Burst Disruptions: generator, dominance filter, and recorded result manifests
description:
Scenario generator, lossless dominance preprocessing, solver drivers, unit tests, and the recorded result manifests for every number reported in the accompanying IEEE Aerospace Conference paper, Cislunar Logistics Design and Worst-Case Verification Under Sustained Transportation Outages.

Each stage manifest under results/ stores SHA-256 hashes of its outputs together with the software versions and, where recorded, the hardware of the producing session. Running src/make_revision_numbers.py against results/ regenerates every numeric macro used in the manuscript.
